items.summary: Nvidia is reshaping its business boundaries in an unprecedented way - transforming from a chip maker into an AI-infrastructure 'financial partner', built around a new cloud-service revenue-sharing model that trades downside support for profit-sharing.

items.title: This week's 'core logic': will the Fed hold rates in September?
items.summary: With US inflation data unexpectedly cooling and jobs and consumption softening, market bets on a September Fed rate hike retreated sharply this week - but abnormal signals at the long end of the bond market, surging oil prices and hawkish officials' insistence are challenging the 'pause narrative'.
